$comment: Portkey gateway presets for Operon. Add your institution's preset here via a pull request. Operon fetches this file on launch (cached 7 days) and merges with the bundled fallback list. Fetched entries win on id collision, so an update here propagates to existing installs without an Operon release.

presets.label: UCI ZotGPT Gateway
presets.description: UC Irvine's institutional AI gateway (powered by Portkey).
presets.eligibility: UCI faculty, staff, graduate students; PI-sponsored undergraduates.
presets.privacy_summary: 12-month retention, no training, P3 compliant, IRB-relevant audit trail.

presets.label: Portkey Cloud
presets.privacy_summary: Portkey's data handling policy applies. Configure providers in the Portkey dashboard.
